<a id="brush_marker_script"></a>
### [`brush_marker_script`](../../../../src/menu/brush_marker_data.asm#L9) `$32DF-$32EE`

*data*

Script with 1 argument: sets 24 cells of colour RAM from $da87 to colour 6, then the cell at $da87 + the argument to colour 5.
